scenario: Windows Agent crash recovery, macOS startup dependency fix, and native browser end-to-end Hub/Web acceptance

agent.snapshot_note: Runtime source matches the final native build manifest; only documentation/evidence changes followed those tests.

server.harness_note: Linux/macOS final run 09 precedes retention of optional driver_diagnostics (two lines only). All scenario assertions are identical to the committed harness. Windows final run 10 includes that retention and the bounded idempotent stop-only transport recovery.

implementation.windows_recovery: Before creating a browser, persist an intent and start an independent child holding query/terminate rights to the unnamed Job plus the parent process identity. Publish and acknowledge the child identity first. On Agent death terminate that Job, wait for ActiveProcesses == 0, persist matching completion, and exit. Recovery validates nonce, complete records, and process creation identities before permitting profile reuse.
implementation.retirement: After native completion, atomically rename the run directory to retired-<session_id> before recursive removal; partial deletion retains an unambiguous cleanup state under the namespace lock.
implementation.macos_startup: Schedule non-page Runtime.runIfWaitingForDebugger work in the existing bounded JoinSet so Fetch.requestPaused can progress while target initialization awaits responses.
implementation.recovery_scope: No old browser session is adopted and no website input is automatically replayed.

execution.macos_specific_app_permission: The user explicitly allowed the test rdh in Local Network settings, then requested continuation.
execution.human_web_client: Local Linux Playwright/Headless Chrome; remote task browsers are native Linux Chrome, macOS Chrome and Win11 Edge.
execution.test_count_meaning: Native tests and Hub pytest parameters each contain several scenarios; repeated diagnostic rounds and six stage groups are not independent model-task samples.

macos.session: Logged-in GUI user launch agent; Keychain available and Local Network explicitly allowed

macos_startup_proof.repeat_source_note: The 20-round cycle exercised the target-initialization fix before later retirement and crash-test additions. Only the final six-case native run and accepted Hub runs are attributed to the final 102-file manifest.

hub_web.default_without_explicit_lan_host: 3 skipped in 0.08s; no remote driver or fixtures allocated
hub_web.deployment: Temporary local PG/Auth/Business/Gate/Core with test-only TLS bridges for both Agent discovery and Core WebSocket; no installed Hub changed.

observations_and_adjustments.change: Persisted intent and independent Job-completion child.
observations_and_adjustments.evidence: Final native crash test covers normal publication and missing owner.json, profile reuse, and an unchanged single website submission count; real Hub crash/restart uses the actual rdh CLI.

observations_and_adjustments.issue: Native Windows recovery hit file sharing error 32 after native process completion; partial deletion could remove ownership metadata.
observations_and_adjustments.evidence: Interrupted-retirement regression and final native/Hub crash tests passed.

observations_and_adjustments.issue: macOS startup dependency cycle reproduced on diagnostic round 17.
observations_and_adjustments.change: Non-page target resume no longer blocks the event pump.
observations_and_adjustments.evidence: Deterministic red/green test, 20 post-fix rounds, and final six-case native run.

observations_and_adjustments.issue: macOS GUI Agent failed LAN discovery with no route while curl from SSH/GUI succeeded.
observations_and_adjustments.change: System log identified Local Network denial. User granted access for this rdh; no global network policy or encryption workaround.
observations_and_adjustments.evidence: platform-tests-02/03 fail before browser scenarios; 04 and 09 pass after authorization.

observations_and_adjustments.issue: Windows test driver held its Start-Process invocation until the redirected Agent exited, then log collection denied concurrent writer access.
observations_and_adjustments.change: Detached launcher with identity acknowledgement, uncertain-start teardown, and FileShare.ReadWrite log reads.
observations_and_adjustments.evidence: platform-tests-05 failure is retained with subsequent verified cleanup.

observations_and_adjustments.issue: Deep Windows fixture paths produced Edge file-name-too-long errors and a failed combined cookie/site-storage retention assertion; PowerShell recursive cleanup also failed on a long path.
observations_and_adjustments.change: Shortened only the disposable configuration path and used an extended path for verified test cleanup. No Agent path-layout change or system long-path setting change.
observations_and_adjustments.evidence: platform-tests-06/07 fail; 08/09 functional groups and 10 complete after shorter fixture path.
observations_and_adjustments.remaining_limit: Arbitrary deep custom configuration paths remain unsupported for reliable browser-profile persistence; launch success does not detect every generated-file path limit.

observations_and_adjustments.issue: Parallels stop command returned PrlJob_GetRetCode: Invalid argument in final suite 09 after all six Windows functional groups passed.
observations_and_adjustments.change: Verified recorded identity and cleaned up explicitly; driver now permits one idempotent retry only for this stop/crash transport error. Startup and browser operations are never retried.
observations_and_adjustments.evidence: Run 09 remains recorded as 2 passed, 1 failed; run 10 Windows passes including automated cleanup.

limits: Windows recovery still quarantines missing/corrupt completion evidence, including simultaneous termination of Agent and cleanup child or a system restart without a completed record; it does not infer completion from a disappeared PID/Job or a fixed delay.
POSIX ownership observes the original process group and does not constrain processes that deliberately escape it.
macOS retained cookies require the normal user Keychain environment; SSH-only launches are not accepted for cookie persistence. GUI LAN connectivity requires the appropriate Local Network grant.
Deep Windows custom configuration paths may break generated browser storage files even when browser_open succeeds; shorter fixture paths passing is not a general long-path guarantee.

Windows ordinary native coverage is the library plus browser integration, not the full workspace. Existing Windows task/service, ProgramData grant fixtures and isolated running-image helper are not run in this pass; macOS plutil-only fixture is skipped.
Native coverage is Linux x64, macOS ARM64 and Win11 ARM64 only. macOS Intel, Windows x64, Linux ARM64/musl and other browser packages require their own evidence.
Human UI automation was from Linux Chromium; this does not verify native Safari/Edge human UI clients, mobile interaction, weak networks or real AI-host rendering and conversation continuation.
Repeated startup diagnosis, these integration tests, and their wall times do not satisfy the model-task matrix, participant usability, long soak, resource hard-cap or performance gates.
Existing constrained download/upload formats and non-atomic observation boundaries remain unchanged. First enablement/browser installation still requires local configuration.
Raw evidence is retained locally in ignored .build paths. Stable public release evidence is not published; commits do not constitute deployment or production acceptance.
